LOGIC ADVENTURE 12 · CLASS 30

Owl’s Secret Code

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Simple codes

Red star = 1, blue heart = 2, yellow sun = 3 — crack the code and finish every row.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · SIMPLE CODES

Owl’s Secret Code

Use the picture code! Star means one, heart means two, sun means three. Tap the number that finishes each row.

The red star… which number does the code say?

The blue heart… which number?

The yellow sun… which number?

Secret code cracked!

Star is 1, heart is 2, sun is 3 — you read the whole code.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Symbol-substitution is early abstract thinking: this picture stands for that number. Read the key aloud together, then let your child decode each row.

Prefer paper? The Owl’s Secret Code worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
